issued: v. 釋出, 發行（issue的過去分詞形式）

v prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
v circulate or distribute or equip with
issuer:
n. 發行者
[法] 發行人, 釋出人
n. an institution that issues something (securities or publications or currency etc.)
issues: n. 議題, 問題；爭點；債券（issue的複數）

n an important question that is in dispute and must be settled
n one of a series published periodically
issuing: v. 出版( issue的現在分詞 ); 發表; 宣佈; 分配; 發行者( issuer的現在分詞 )

n the act of providing an item for general use or for official purposes (usually in quantity)
v prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
ist: abbr. 胰島素休克療法（insulin shock therapy）；星際航行（Interplanetary Space Travel）；獨立懸掛減震系統（Independent Suspension Technology）
isthmian:
n. 地峽區域之居民
a. 地峽的,靠近地峽的,形成地峽的
a of or relating to or forming an isthmus
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">拉丁語 isthmius（形容詞，地峽的，源自希臘語 isthmios，源自 isthmos（isthmus，地峽））＋英語名詞字尾 -an</dd></dl>
isthmic:
n. 地峽區域之居民
a. 地峽的,靠近地峽的,形成地峽的
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">拉丁語 isthmicus，源自希臘語 isthmikos，源自 isthmos（isthmus，地峽）＋-ikos（-ic）</dd></dl>
isthmus:
n. 地峽, 峽部
[醫] 峽

n. a relatively narrow strip of land (with water on both sides) connecting two larger land areas
n. a cord-like tissue connecting two larger parts of an anatomical structure
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，地理用語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>拉丁／希臘 isthmos「地峽」，沒有可拆解的字根</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>the Isthmus of Panama</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">指連接兩塊陸地、兩側臨水的狹長陸地</dd></dl>
istle: n. 中、南美洲產的各種熱帶植物纖維
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">美洲西班牙語 ixtle，源自納瓦特爾語 ichtli</dd></dl>
isuzu: n. 五十鈴汽車（日本汽車品牌）
